Should seizures recur under ei- ther regimen, then an additional intravenous dose of 2 to 4 g can be given. It is essential to monitor for signs of hypermagnesaemia, and to stop magnesium dosage should this occur. Doses should be reduced in renal im- pairment. The use of magnesium sulfate in acute myocardial infarction and premature labour is discussed below.
